Receiver r17 confirms update confirmation opens, OE6.0 catalogue refresh completes with no packages changed, and oscam-master starts again afterward. r18 adds verified native stop/restart in the existing asynchronous worker: init script, bounded wait, exact-executable SIGTERM, bounded wait and SIGKILL only if still running. Host Linux integration verifies missing-PID-file shutdown, SIGTERM-resistant process escalation and survival of a different executable. 82 host tests pass. r18 shutdown/restart still requires receiver validation.
